tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe speech from an audio file at a public URL, or uploaded in a POST body, using Whisper large-v3-turbo. Returns the transcript text, detected language, duration and word count; subtitles=srt or vtt adds subtitle text and timestamps=true adds timed segments and words. Accepts common formats s

tools.name: ai_speech
tools.description: Turn up to 300 characters of text into natural, human-sounding speech as an MP3 (base64), in English (40 voices) or Spanish (10 voices), with Deepgram Aura-2. Pick a voice by name or leave the default. Use for voice replies, audio notes, accessibility and phone or chat bots; for up to 2,000 characte

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Text to speech for a paragraph or a page: turn up to 2,000 characters of text into natural, human-sounding speech as one MP3 (base64), in English (40 voices) or Spanish (10 voices), with Deepgram Aura-2. Pick a voice by name or leave the default. Use for narration, article and summary read-outs, voi

tools.name: transcribe_long
tools.description: Transcribe a podcast, meeting, interview or lecture: up to 60 minutes of MP3 or WAV (25 MB) by URL or uploaded in a POST body, 90+ languages, Whisper large-v3-turbo. Parts are joined, so subtitles=srt or vtt and timestamps=true cover the whole recording; longer audio is refused before anything runs.

tools.name: transcribe_summary
tools.description: Summarize a voice note, meeting, call or podcast in one call: transcribes up to 60 minutes (MP3/WAV up to 25 MB; M4A, OGG or WebM up to 5 MB) by URL or upload, then returns a title, summary, key points, action items with owner and due date, open questions and the transcript, in the recording's langu

tools.name: text_to_speech_lite
tools.description: Low-cost text to speech for longer English text: up to 2,000 characters as one MP3 (base64) with Deepgram Aura-1, 12 voices. Half the price per character of text_to_speech, with a slightly less natural voice. Pick a voice by name or leave the default. Use for narration drafts, read-aloud of articles

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "voice" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: transcribe_summary, text_to_speech_lite · Private data: transcribe · Public sink: transcribe, transcribe_long, transcribe_summary · Destructive: transcribe_long.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: transcribe_summary, text_to_speech_lite · Private data: transcribe · Public sink: transcribe, transcribe_long, transcribe_summary · Destructive: transcribe_long

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
